about: Apart-register entries retired by R28 (20 October 2026): with Law.* abbreviations at Law.process, these theorems reach the Process family by definition and are no longer apart roots. Bytes as they stood in THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY-APART.json.

Becoming.Law.Lossless.unlisted.reason: Branching.Lossless.unlisted at Law.process next with the run Law.run next s states it on the base (through law_lossless_iff and law_returns_iff).
